content: It's important to communicate with respect, even when frustrated. Instead of saying something harmful, try expressing your feelings calmly: *"I’m disappointed you couldn’t help, but I understand. Maybe next time?"* This keeps the relationship positive while acknowledging your emotions. Harmful words can damage trust and create unnecessary conflict.
